Yes
The design is sound, minimal, and enforceable without false positives. Committing a real-shape corpus across at least five families before the red phase ensures the checker rules account for diverse XML/MSBuild structures, lockfile lines, and page prose variations (including whitespace and CDATA). Measuring the reference against real repository files and corpus encodings prevents brittle parsing and false positives. The sequencing of light work ahead of heavy runs under the cross-mob lock keeps enforcement clean and sound.
